description-zh: 对普通对象/数组进行深拷贝
description-en: Deep clone plain objects and arrays
code: function deepClone(obj){ if(obj===null||typeof obj!=='object') return obj; if(Array.isArray(obj)) return obj.map(deepClone); const cloned={}; for(const k in obj){ if(Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(obj,k)) cloned[k]=deepClone(obj[k]); } return cloned; }

description-zh: 安全地从嵌套对象取值，支持默认值
description-en: Safely get nested object value with default
code: function safeGet(obj,path,defaultVal=undefined){ const keys=path.split('.'); let cur=obj; for(const k of keys){ if(cur==null||typeof cur!=='object') return defaultVal; cur=cur[k]; } return cur===undefined?defaultVal:cur; }

description-zh: 函数节流，每 delay ms 最多执行一次
description-en: Throttle function execution to once per delay ms
code: function throttle(fn,delay){ let last=0; return function(...args){ const now=Date.now(); if(now-last>=delay){ last=now; fn.apply(this,args); } }; }

description-zh: 函数防抖，delay ms 无新调用才执行
description-en: Debounce: execute only after delay ms of no calls
code: function debounce(fn,delay){ let timer=null; return function(...args){ clearTimeout(timer); timer=setTimeout(()=>{ fn.apply(this,args); timer=null; },delay); }; }

description-zh: 生成从 start 到 end（不包含）的整数数组
description-en: Generate integer array from start to end (exclusive)
code: function range(start,end,step=1){ const arr=[]; if(step===0) return arr; if(step>0) for(let i=start;i<end;i+=step) arr.push(i); else for(let i=start;i>end;i+=step) arr.push(i); return arr; }

description-zh: 生成指定范围内的随机整数
description-en: Generate random integer in range
code: function randInt(min,max){ return Math.floor(Math.random()*(max-min+1))+min; }

description-zh: 将多维数组展平为一维
description-en: Flatten multi-dimensional array to one dimension
code: function flatten(arr,depth=Infinity){ let res=[]; for(const x of arr){ if(Array.isArray(x)&&depth>0) res.push(...flatten(x,depth-1)); else res.push(x); } return res; }

description-zh: 按键函数对数组元素分组
description-en: Group array elements by key function
code: function groupBy(arr,keyFn){ return arr.reduce((acc,item)=>{ const key=keyFn(item); if(!acc[key]) acc[key]=[]; acc[key].push(item); return acc; },{}); }

description-zh: 随机打乱数组顺序（原地）
description-en: Randomly shuffle array in place
code: function shuffle(arr){ for(let i=arr.length-1;i>0;i--){ const j=Math.floor(Math.random()*(i+1)); [arr[i],arr[j]]=[arr[j],arr[i]]; } return arr; }

description-zh: 将多元函数转换为嵌套二元函数
description-en: Curry a function of multiple arguments
code: function curry(fn){ return function curried(...args){ return args.length>=fn.length? fn.apply(this,args): function(...rest){ return curried(...args,...rest); }; }; }

description-zh: 为 Promise 设置超时，超时则 reject
description-en: Add timeout to Promise, reject on timeout
code: function promiseTimeout(p,ms){ return new Promise((res,rej)=>{ const t=setTimeout(()=>rej(new Error('timeout')),ms); p.then(v=>{clearTimeout(t);res(v);}).catch(e=>{clearTimeout(t);rej(e);}); }); }

description-zh: 顺序执行 Promise 数组并收集结果
description-en: Execute array of promises sequentially and collect results
code: async function promiseChain(fns){ const results=[]; for(const fn of fns){ results.push(await fn()); } return results; }

description-zh: 限制并发数量的异步任务池
description-en: Run async tasks with concurrency limit
code: async function concurrencyLimit(tasks,limit){ const results=[]; const executing=new Set(); for(const task of tasks){ const p=Promise.resolve().then(()=>task()); executing.add(p); const clean=()=>executing.delete(p); p.then(clean).catch(clean); if(executing.size>=limit) await Promise.race(executing); } return Promise.all(executing); }

description-zh: 创建对象的浅拷贝
description-en: Create shallow copy of object
code: function shallowCopy(obj){ return {...obj}; }

description-zh: 将数字格式化为金额字符串（如 ¥1,234.56）

code: function currencyFormat(num,locale='zh-CN',currency='CNY'){ return new Intl.NumberFormat(locale,{style:'currency',currency}).format(num); }

description-zh: 计算两个日期之间的天数差
description-en: Calculate days between two dates
code: function dateDiff(d1,d2){ const diff=Math.abs(d1.getTime()-d2.getTime()); return Math.ceil(diff/(1000*60*60*24)); }

description-zh: 解析 URL 为对象
description-en: Parse URL to object
code: function parseURL(url){ return new URL(url); }

description-zh: 将对象转换为 URL 查询字符串

description-zh: 将 URL 查询字符串解析为对象
description-en: Parse URL query string to object
code: function parseQueryString(qs){ return Object.fromEntries(new URLSearchParams(qs)); }

description-zh: 将数字四舍五入到指定小数位
description-en: Round number to specified decimal places
code: function roundTo(num,decimals){ return Math.round(num*10**decimals)/10**decimals; }

description-zh: 将字符串首字母转换为大写
description-en: Capitalize first letter of string
code: function capitalize(s){ return s.charAt(0).toUpperCase()+s.slice(1); }

description-zh: 将一个范围的数值映射到另一个范围
description-en: Map value from one range to another
code: function rangeMap(value,inMin,inMax,outMin,outMax){ return ((value-inMin)/(inMax-inMin))*(outMax-outMin)+outMin; }

description-zh: 删除指定名称的 Cookie
description-en: Delete cookie by name
code: function deleteCookie(name){ document.cookie=`${name}=;expires=Thu,01Jan197000:00:00:00GMT;path=/`; }

description-zh: 通过 Blob 下载文件
description-en: Download file via Blob
code: function downloadFile(content,filename,type='text/plain'){ const blob=new Blob([content],{type}); const url=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=url; a.download=filename; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a); URL.revokeObjectURL(url); }
